description: This file is a Dart source file that runs a block of code immediately upon import to provide CI guidance within a Flutter project. It checks for the existence of specific files and directories to verify the project root and prints guidance messages if the expected structure is not found.

methods.name: _rootCheck
methods.description: A boolean variable initialized with the result of an immediate execution function. This function checks for the presence of project root files and directories to determine if the code is running within the expected Flutter project structure.
